text: {"bodies": ["In our cross-team leak meeting, Riikka Laitinen (e35) came up across Legal again, echoing that Day 4 doc thread on the Finance headcount plan.", "Following up on the doc review, Riikka Laitinen (e35) was indeed the last one on the Project Falcon roadmap, which aligns with Pihla Nieminen's Day 4 meeting point.", "Ever since Day 2's doc meeting friction, Tuomas Rantanen (e22) is right back to hoarding drafts for the Project Saimaa roadmap and Project Falcon roadmap behind closed doors."]}
